scope: CVG-003 bounded account-scoped triage collection, version history, creation and update application boundary

criteria.description: Triage hydration, collection, detail, version history, creation and update require a valid AccountId; the service filters records and versions before returning or mutating them and rejects missing context.
criteria.limitations: The service boundary is proven locally; a caller outside the tenant transaction wrapper is not a database atomicity guarantee.

criteria.description: Triage repository detail, encounter, collection, version and update queries use parameterized account predicates; existing RLS remains an additional database control.
criteria.limitations: This does not certify privileged SQL writers outside the application repository or target deployment RLS.

criteria.description: Authenticated triage routes derive tenant scope from the principal, reject an explicit empty encounter filter and deny cross-account list, history, PATCH and POST access in a two-account HTTP fixture.
criteria.limitations: The HTTP fixture uses the repository's local MockRequest/MockResponse dispatcher and fake repositories; it is not TCP-to-PostgreSQL target evidence.

criteria.description: Returned triage models and history snapshots are defensive copies, speculative create/update cache state is restored on persistence failure, and POST validation/persistence precedes encounter transition.
criteria.limitations: Repository update and version creation remain two sequential calls when no outer tenant transaction owns them.

criteria.description: TDD RED is recorded, corrected tests/builds/typechecks/static hygiene pass, PostgreSQL persistence passes and official repository coverage remains above the required threshold.
criteria.limitations: Aggregate lint remains blocked by 45 unused-symbol diagnostics in unrelated dirty files; scoped triage lint passes.

criteria.description: A fresh independent read-only reviewer inspected the final service, repository, route and tests and returned PASS_BOUNDED without Critical or High findings.
criteria.limitations: The reviewer retained Medium residuals for transaction-wrapper dependence, local HTTP/RLS limits and unrelated aggregate lint, plus a Low test-gap observation.

criteria.description: The bounded result is reconciled without promoting CVG-003 or global gates; parity, clinical parity and enterprise readiness remain at their observed partial/open states.
criteria.limitations: General parity is 98/100 with 4/11 verified, clinical parity is 100/100 with 2/3 verified and enterprise readiness is 95/100 with 42 PASS, 3 WARN and 1 FAIL.

gaps: The repository update and version insert are only atomic when an outer tenant transaction wrapper owns both calls.
The HTTP proof uses local dispatcher/fake repositories and does not replace TCP-to-target PostgreSQL/RLS evidence.
Aggregate lint has unrelated baseline diagnostics in the mixed dirty worktree.
Target behavior, privileged writers, other clinical routes, providers, Live Lab, accessibility, operations, remote CI, backup/restore, remaining parity and release acceptance remain open.
conditions: Keep required AccountId context and principal-derived route scope.
Do not broaden empty filters or reintroduce unscoped triage repository predicates.
Revalidate before changing hydration, tenant context, authorization, transaction ownership, direct SQL, target or production scope.

authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via the original consolidation brief
authority.scope: CVG-003 bounded triage collection, history and update tenant isolation
authority.decision: Authorize reversible repository-local triage service/repository/route/test correction and local verification of account-scoped triage collection, history and update boundaries; exclude migrations, direct SQL beyond the repository query correction, target, providers, credentials, production, deployment, external mutation and release acceptance.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before expanding beyond triage collection, history and update application boundaries.

next_action: Keep CVG-003 and the global program IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL. Continue with the next separately authorized gap; do not promote this bounded result to clinical parity, enterprise readiness or release.
revalidation_triggers: Any new triage collection, detail, version-history, creation or update path
Changes to runtime hydration, tenant context, authorization, transaction ownership or triage persistence
Any expansion to target, provider, credential, production, deployment or release acceptance
